Refund Policy

Last updated: 2026-09-26

Summary

One-time donations are generally non-refundable. If a recurring donation is unused and you contact us promptly, we can review a refund request for the current month.

How to request help

Email business@fedpromptly.com with the subject “Refund Request.” Include the date, amount, processor, and transaction ID if available. We aim to respond within five business days.

Processor controls

PayPal, Stripe, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, and NOWPayments may have their own cancellation and dispute procedures. Crypto payments may be final after confirmation. Please contact us before filing a chargeback so we can investigate.

Exceptions

Requests older than 30 days are reviewed at our discretion and may be limited by processor rules or inability to identify the transaction.
